scenes.text: 孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

corrections.correction: …他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里 → …他的朋友喜欢在墓地里玩
corrections.explanation: 墓地里 is the location, so use 在+Place before the action: 在墓地里玩.

corrections.correction: 跟妈妈搬家 → 跟妈妈搬了家
corrections.explanation: This move was completed in the past, so add 了 after 搬: 搬了家.

corrections.correction: 装祭拜 → 装作祭拜
corrections.explanation: 装 needs 作 to mean “pretend to.” Use 装作+V., as in 装作祭拜.

corrections.correction: ⟦孟子⟧小的时候
corrections.explanation: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 孟子 briefly with an identifying noun phrase, not only his name.

corrections.correction: 而是因为妈妈认为他们… → 而是妈妈认为他们…
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to delete 因为, because 而是 already introduces the real reason.

alternatives.note: A slightly more descriptive word for children playing.
Means playing happily and noisily; it gives the scene a livelier tone.
Means “be close to” and is useful for describing locations.
Means right next to or very close beside, so it is stronger than “near.”

expressiveness.where: 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。
expressiveness.idea: Add that they laughed while pretending, so the scene feels more lively and shows why other visitors might be unhappy.
expressiveness.example: 他们一边笑，一边装祭拜。

expressiveness.where: 而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。
expressiveness.idea: Add a short thought or spoken line from his mother to show that she worries about the trouble this place may cause.
expressiveness.example: 妈妈想：“这儿麻烦太多了，我们得搬家。”

feedback.encouragement: You clearly show that Mencius often played with his friends and include the detail that he was only five when he moved. You also give the reader a clear reason for the family’s move.

scenes.text: 妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。

corrections.correction: 住离墓地太近 → 住得离墓地太近
corrections.explanation: Use 得 after 住 to introduce the degree complement: 住得离墓地太近.

corrections.correction: …子思老师的家，跟子思老师住 → …子思老师的家住
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to delete 跟子思老师 because 子思老师的家 already shows where they live.

corrections.correction: 害得孟子的心气 → 害得孟子心情不好
corrections.explanation: After 害得 + N/sb., use a harmful result. 心情不好 gives the result for 孟子.

corrections.correction: 孟子和⟦孟母⟧搬到子思老师…
corrections.explanation: 孟母 appears for the first time here, so please introduce her briefly, for example as 孟子的妈妈.

corrections.correction: 他老是读书 → 所以他老是读书
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to use 所以 to show the result: because he has no friends, he reads books often.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。

alternatives.note: means to tidy and put things in order; it can sound a little broader than cleaning.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。

alternatives.note: means to cook, with a warmer and slightly more vivid tone.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。

alternatives.note: also means “always,” and emphasizes that the action happens again and again.
means “often” and gives a more neutral description of a habit.

expressiveness.where: 妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。
expressiveness.idea: Add that Mother is worried and show her thought about needing to move again.
expressiveness.example: 妈妈很着急，心想：“不能再住在这儿了。”

expressiveness.where: 孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。
expressiveness.idea: Add Mother’s happy words about this new place being good for Mengzi’s study.
expressiveness.example: 孟母很高兴，说：“这儿很适合孩子学习。”

expressiveness.where: 因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。
expressiveness.idea: Describe how quietly and regularly Mengzi studies in his new environment.
expressiveness.example: 他每天安安静静地看书学习。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly show the new relationship between Mengzi, his mother, and Teacher Zisi. You also explain why Mengzi begins to study more, so the scene has a clear cause and result.

scenes.text: 子思认为，对孩子来说，读书最重要，特别是学哲学。孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。孟子从五岁一直学哲学。他才五岁就学哲学，难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。

corrections.correction: 孟子从五岁一直学哲学 → 孟子从五岁起一直学哲学
corrections.explanation: Use 从五岁起一直学哲学 to show that the action started at age five and continued.

corrections.correction: 就是看哲学书 → 就是看到哲学书
corrections.explanation: 孟子 actually sees the philosophy books, so use 看到see, not 看look.

corrections.correction: 难怪他成为很有名的… → 难怪成为很有名的…
corrections.explanation: 孟子 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete the redundant 他; Chinese uses zero form here.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 对孩子来说，读书最重要

alternatives.note: A broader, slightly more formal word for studying and learning.
A more formal word for books, often used when talking about books as a group.
A more formal word meaning famous or well-known.
Means well-known, with a neutral and natural tone.

expressiveness.where: 子思认为，对孩子来说，读书最重要，特别是学哲学。
expressiveness.idea: You could add a short sentence showing Zi Si encouraging Mencius to study seriously.
expressiveness.example: 子思对孟子说：“你要认真读书。”

expressiveness.where: 孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。
expressiveness.idea: You could describe that Mencius finds philosophy interesting and enjoys learning it.
expressiveness.example: 他觉得哲学很有意思，所以每天都认真学习。

expressiveness.where: 他才五岁就学哲学，难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。
expressiveness.idea: You could add his mother’s happy reaction when she sees that this environment helps him learn.
expressiveness.example: 孟母看见孟子爱读书，心里很高兴。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly show that Mencius studied philosophy from a very young age and connect this to his later success. The pattern “不是……就是……” also makes his daily study routine sound clear and active.

content: After the family leaves the graveyard, add that they move near the market and 孟子 copies buying and selling.
Before 孟子 studies every day, add that the family moves from the market to a neighborhood near a school.
Wrong information: “孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。” — This replaces the required move to the neighborhood near the market, and later the move to the neighborhood near the school.

scenes.text: 有一天孟子去了墓地玩儿，但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩，所以她决定了他们会搬家找更好的地方。她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福，而且住在这儿教育不太好。因为她望子成龙，所以她会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育。然后他们搬到了离城市更近的地方。

corrections.correction: …妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩 → …妈妈觉得这是不适合让孩子玩的地方
corrections.explanation: the whole action 让孩子玩 needs to modify 地方, so use the 的 structure.

corrections.correction: 所以她会一直搬家才能… → 所以她要一直搬家才能…
corrections.explanation: 会 does not normally collocate with 一直搬家才能 in this necessary-condition meaning; use 要…才能 instead.

corrections.correction: 有一天⟦孟子⟧去了墓地玩儿
corrections.explanation: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 孟子 briefly, for example 孟子小时候.

corrections.correction: 而且住在这儿教育不太好 → 而且这儿的教育不太好
corrections.explanation: use 的 to show that 这儿 modifies 教育.

corrections.correction: 所以她会一直搬家才… → 所以会一直搬家才…
corrections.explanation: 她 is redundant because the subject is already clear from the previous clause; Chinese uses zero form here.

corrections.correction: 所以她决定了他们会搬家找… → 所以她决定他们会搬家找…
corrections.explanation: 决定 is a mental state verb here, so use no 了.

corrections.correction: 有一天孟子去了墓地玩儿 → 有一天孟子去墓地玩儿
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 去墓地玩儿 without 了 here; this opening sentence does not need 了 to connect to a previous event.

corrections.correction: …搬家找更好的地方 → …搬家找更好的
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to delete 地方 because 更好的 already expresses the intended meaning here.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩

alternatives.note: This sounds a little more formal and shows a considered opinion.
This emphasizes the mother's worry about her child.
This means more suitable, especially for a child or a home.
This gives a specific quality of a better place to live.
This means repeatedly or without stopping.
This means again and again, often after careful consideration.

expressiveness.where: 孟子去了墓地玩儿
expressiveness.idea: Add what Mengzi sees there and why he finds it interesting.
expressiveness.example: 他看见很多人来祭拜，觉得很有趣。

expressiveness.where: 但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩
expressiveness.idea: Add a short thought from his mother to show her worry more directly.
expressiveness.example: 她心想：“不能让孩子在这儿玩。”

expressiveness.where: 然后他们搬到了离城市更近的地方
expressiveness.idea: Add one detail about the new area, such as the busy shops and people.
expressiveness.example: 那儿有很多商人卖东西，很热闹。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly explain the mother’s reason for moving and connect it to her hope for Mengzi’s future. You also use “望子成龙” well to show her strong wish for her son.

scenes.text: 他们住才一月就又搬家。古代的时候，一般人不喜欢卖东西的人。但是孟子老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿，害得妈妈着急得很，因为她恐怕儿子会成为跟他们很像。她告诉了孟子：他们不是朋友，而是不好的人。

corrections.correction: 他们住才一月就又搬… → 他们住了才一月就又搬…
corrections.explanation: Use 了 after 住 to show that this period of living was completed before they moved again.

corrections.correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代
corrections.explanation: 古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。

corrections.correction: 他们住才一月就又搬家 → 他们住才一个月就又搬家
corrections.explanation: Use 一个月 for a duration of one month; 一月 is usually the name of the month January.

corrections.correction: …一月就又搬家 → …一月就又搬家了
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to add 了 after 搬家 to show the move was completed.

corrections.correction: …她恐怕儿子会成为跟他们很像 → …她恐怕儿子会变得跟他们很像
corrections.explanation: Use 变得 before the adjective phrase 很像. 成为 is used before a noun or role.

corrections.correction: …子：他们不是朋友 → …子：他们不是你的朋友
corrections.explanation: It would be clearer to add 你的 to show that these people are not Mencius's friends.

corrections.correction: 她告诉了孟子：他们不… → 她告诉孟子：他们不…
corrections.explanation: 告诉 introduces quoted speech, so use no 了 for the speaking word.

corrections.correction: …些卖东西的人常常玩儿 → …些卖东西的人玩儿
corrections.explanation: 老是 already means “often/always,” so 常常 is redundant here.

corrections.correction: 因为她恐怕儿子会成为跟… → 因为她担心儿子会成为跟…
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 担心 because it directly expresses that the mother worries about her son.

alternatives.note: means “worried”; it focuses on fearing what may happen to her son.
means “very anxious”; it is a little stronger than 着急.
means “not suitable”; it sounds less harsh and fits the mother’s concern about the environment.
means “not serious/diligent”; it can describe the behavior she does not want Mengzi to copy.

expressiveness.where: 古代的时候，一般人不喜欢卖东西的人。
expressiveness.idea: You could describe the busy market and the many different things the sellers had, to show why Mengzi found it interesting.
expressiveness.example: 市场里很热闹，有很多人卖东西。

expressiveness.where: 但是孟子老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿，
expressiveness.idea: Add that he copied the sellers, such as calling to customers or learning to take money.
expressiveness.example: 他还学他们收钱，叫别人买东西。

expressiveness.where: 她告诉了孟子：他们不是朋友，而是不好的人。
expressiveness.idea: Give the mother a fuller warning to show that she was worried about his learning.
expressiveness.example: 妈妈说：“你应该好好学习，不要老跟他们玩儿。”

feedback.encouragement: You clearly explain why Mengzi’s mother is worried, using “害得妈妈着急得很.” You also connect this scene to the earlier moves by showing that they move again after only a short time.

scenes.text: 你不是当数学家，而是当哲学家，不能当卖东西的人。所以他们又搬家。在他们第三个家，孟子学了怎么祭拜。妈妈感觉这个地方适合他们，告诉了孟子：我们找到了最后的家。在这儿妈妈让儿子从早到晚学习，他难怪成为有名的哲学家。

corrections.correction: 而是当哲学家 → 而是当哲学家的
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 而是当哲学家的. The particle 的 links the contrastive description to the following person.

corrections.correction: …他们第三个家 → …他们第三个家里
corrections.explanation: 在他们第三个家 does not normally collocate as a place expression; use 在他们第三个家里 instead.

corrections.correction: 他难怪成为有名的哲… → 难怪他成为有名的哲…
corrections.explanation: 难怪 normally comes before the subject. Use 难怪他成为有名的哲学家.

corrections.correction: 孟子学了怎么祭拜 → 孟子学会了怎么祭拜
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 孟子学会了怎么祭拜. 学会 means “learn to be able to do,” while 学 alone does not clearly show this result.

corrections.correction: 告诉了孟子：我们找… → 告诉孟子：我们找…
corrections.explanation: 告诉 introduces quoted speech, so use no 了 for the speaking word.

corrections.correction: …以他们又搬家 → …以他们又搬家了
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 又搬家了. 又 shows that moving happened again, and 了 marks the completed move.

alternatives.note: A very natural word for saying that a place is suitable.
Stronger: it means the place is especially good or ideal.
A more formal and stronger word for “famous.”
A common, conversational way to say “well-known.”
More specific when he is learning by reading books.
Shows that he studies hard.

expressiveness.where: 所以他们又搬家。
expressiveness.idea: Add that this time they moved next to a school, so the new place felt better for learning.
expressiveness.example: 这一次，他们搬到了学校旁边。

expressiveness.where: 妈妈感觉这个地方适合他们，告诉了孟子：我们找到了最后的家。
expressiveness.idea: Show the mother’s happiness and let her explain that the environment is good for her child.
expressiveness.example: 妈妈很高兴，说：“这儿很适合你学习。”

expressiveness.where: 在这儿妈妈让儿子从早到晚学习
expressiveness.idea: Add a small detail about what Mencius did at school, such as reading books and studying.
expressiveness.example: 孟子每天在学校看书学习。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly showed that Mengzi became a philosopher because of his mother’s choices. You also used direct speech for the mother, which helps make the scene more story-like.

content: After they move to the place near the market, add that 孟子 copies buying and selling before they move again.

Wrong information: “在他们第三个家，孟子学了怎么祭拜。” — This puts 孟子 learning sacrifices in the third home, after the market part. In the story, the sacrifice imitation belongs to the opening graveyard setting; the third home is where he begins studying.

scenes.text: 古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

corrections.correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代
corrections.explanation: 古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。

corrections.correction: 但是城市有才两个学校 → 但是城市才有两个学校
corrections.explanation: Put 才 before 有 here: 才有两个学校 means “there are only two schools.”

corrections.correction: …是城市有才两个学校 → …是城市有才两所学校
corrections.explanation: Use 所 for schools: 一所学校. 个 is a general measure word, but 所 is the usual measure word for a school.

corrections.correction: 一个男孩子跟⟦他⟧的妈妈住在中…
corrections.explanation: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce his mother briefly with a noun phrase, such as 孟子的妈妈, instead of only using 他。

corrections.correction: …孟子老是祭拜 → …孟子老是祭拜他们
corrections.explanation: It would be clearer to add 他们, because both Mengzi and his mother live next to the cemetery and may worship there.

alternatives.note: This means “nearby” and gives a slightly broader sense of location.
This also means “always” or “again and again,” with a neutral tone.
This means “like/love” and sounds a little more expressive.

expressiveness.where: 所以孟子老是祭拜。
expressiveness.idea: You could add that he finds the funeral rituals interesting and is copying what he sees.
expressiveness.example: 他觉得祭拜很有意思，就学别人祭拜。

expressiveness.where: 孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。
expressiveness.idea: You could describe that he laughs while playing at worshipping, which makes the real visitors unhappy.
expressiveness.example: 他一边笑一边祭拜，别人很生气。

expressiveness.where: 他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。
expressiveness.idea: You could add the mother’s worried thought or speech after she sees this behavior.
expressiveness.example: 妈妈说：“我们应该搬家。”

feedback.encouragement: You clearly introduce Mengzi, his mother, and their home near the cemetery. You also use the useful pattern “不是……就是……” to show what Mengzi often does.

scenes.text: 他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市，而是想孟子有很好的教育。他们搬家到有很多学校的城市。他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨。

corrections.correction: 而是想孟子有很好的… → 而是想让孟子有很好的…
corrections.explanation: 想 cannot be followed directly by a person and a noun here. Use 想让 + person + verb: 想让孟子接受很好的教育.

corrections.correction: 而是想孟子有很好的教育 → 而是想孟子接受很好的教育
corrections.explanation: We normally say 接受很好的教育, not 有很好的教育. Use 接受 for receiving an education.

corrections.correction: 他难怪抱怨 → 难怪他抱怨
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to put 难怪 before the subject: 难怪他抱怨. 难怪 introduces the reason that explains the subject's action.

corrections.correction: 他们搬家到有很多学校… → 他们搬到有很多学校…
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 搬到有很多学校的城市. Here 搬到 already expresses moving to the city.

corrections.correction: 他们搬家到有很多学校的… → 他们搬家到了有很多学校的…
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to add 了 because the move is completed in the story: 搬到了. This is 了completed.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市

alternatives.note: A more formal word for “mother.”
A story-like way to refer to Mengzi's mother.
More formal; often used for a good education or environment.
Shows that the mother wants an improved education.
Means travelling quickly or for a long time to reach a place.
A more formal word for travelling on foot.

expressiveness.where: 他们搬家到有很多学校的城市。
expressiveness.idea: Add a detail about the new place, such as students reading and studying near the schools.
expressiveness.example: 学校旁边有很多学生在看书。

expressiveness.where: 他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨。
expressiveness.idea: Add what Mengzi says to show that he is tired of walking.
expressiveness.example: 孟子说：“妈妈，我很累，我不想走了。”

expressiveness.where: 他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市，而是想孟子有很好的教育。
expressiveness.idea: Add the mother's hopeful feeling that this new environment will be good for Mengzi's learning.
expressiveness.example: 妈妈觉得这儿很适合孟子学习。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly explain the mother’s reason for moving: she wants Mengzi to have a good education. You also include Mengzi’s complaint, which gives this scene a character feeling.

scenes.text: 他难怪抱怨，他想他的朋友，因为他不要离开他的城市。他的妈妈找到孟子一个老师。跟老师孟子学最重要的文学，所以他成为哲学家。

corrections.correction: …妈妈找到孟子一个老师 → …妈妈找到孟子的老师
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 孟子的老师. 孟子 describes 老师, so use 的.

corrections.correction: 跟老师孟子学最重要的文… → 孟子跟老师学最重要的文…
corrections.explanation: 孟子 is the subject, so put it before 跟老师: 孟子跟老师学最重要的文学.

corrections.correction: 因为他不要离开他的城市 → 因为他不想离开他的城市
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 想 here: 因为他不想离开他的城市 means he does not want to leave his city.

corrections.correction: 他想他的朋友 → 想他的朋友
corrections.explanation: 他 is already clear from the previous clause, so it is redundant. Delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.

corrections.correction: 因为他不要离开他的… → 因为不要离开他的…
corrections.explanation: 他 is already clear in the close continuation, so it is redundant. Delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.

corrections.correction: 所以他成为哲学家 → 所以他成为了哲学家
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to use 了completed because becoming a philosopher is a completed change in the story.

corrections.correction: 他的妈妈找到孟子一个老师 → 他的妈妈给孟子找到一个老师
corrections.explanation: Use 给孟子 to show that his mother found a teacher for Mencius. The person receiving the help comes after 给.

alternatives.note: This means to complain repeatedly, often in an unhappy tone.
This can stress blaming the situation or another person.
This means hometown and shows a more personal, emotional connection.

expressiveness.where: 他难怪抱怨
expressiveness.idea: You could show that he was unhappy because he missed his friends and did not want to leave his old home.
expressiveness.example: 他很不高兴，因为他想朋友。

expressiveness.where: 他的妈妈找到孟子一个老师。
expressiveness.idea: Add the mother’s happy reaction when she sees that the new place is good for Mengzi’s learning.
expressiveness.example: 妈妈很高兴，说：“这儿很适合学习。”

expressiveness.where: 跟老师孟子学最重要的文学
expressiveness.idea: Add a small detail about Mengzi studying, such as reading books with his teacher.
expressiveness.example: 孟子每天跟老师看书学习。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly explain why Mengzi complained: he missed his friends and did not want to leave his city. You also include the important ending that his learning helped him become a philosopher.

content: After leaving the graveyard and before moving to the school city, add that 孟母 moved near a market and 孟子 copied people buying and selling.
After the market scene, add that 孟母 moved from the market to a home near a school before 孟子 began studying.
At the end, say that 孟子 became a famous philosopher.

scenes.text: 古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

corrections.correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代
corrections.explanation: 古代 is the story’s time/place setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。

corrections.correction: 哪些植物不能吃 → 哪些不能吃
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural not to repeat 植物. After 哪些植物能吃, you can say 哪些不能吃.

corrections.correction: 一看很多人正在吃… → 看到很多人正在吃…
corrections.explanation: Shennong actually sees this situation, so use 看到see, not 看look.

corrections.correction: 神农想帮别人 → 神农想帮了别人
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 帮了别人 if this helping is completed in the story; use 了completed for a completed action.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 很多人正在吃一些植物

alternatives.note: A slightly more written and natural word for “many.”
Means “quite a few” and adds variety.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 一些人一吃植物就生病了

alternatives.note: Means to become so sick that someone falls ill seriously.
A softer phrase for feeling unwell.
Means to find out clearly after trying to understand.
Means to learn about or understand something.

expressiveness.where: 一些人一吃植物就生病了，
expressiveness.idea: You could show that the sick people feel very uncomfortable after eating the plants.
expressiveness.example: 他们肚子疼，难受得不得了。

expressiveness.where: 神农想帮别人。
expressiveness.idea: You could add Shen Nong’s own words to show his strong wish to help.
expressiveness.example: 他想：“我一定要帮他们！”

expressiveness.where: 所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。
expressiveness.idea: You could add that people did not know which plants were safe, making Shen Nong’s decision more important.
expressiveness.example: 因为大家都不知道什么植物有毒。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly explain the problem at the start: people eat plants and become sick. You also show Shen Nong’s kind purpose in wanting to help others.

scenes.text: 然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。

corrections.correction: 一些植物吃真好 → 一些植物很好吃
corrections.explanation: 很好吃 is the usual adjective phrase for “tastes good.” Say 植物很好吃, not 吃真好.

corrections.correction: 一些植物毒得很 → 一些植物有毒得很
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to use the Adj. 有毒 here: 有毒 means “poisonous.”

corrections.correction: 一些植物毒得很 → 一些植物毒
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 有毒, without 得很. 有毒 is already an Adj. phrase describing the plants.

alternatives.note: This emphasizes that there are many different kinds.
This is a slightly more written-style word for “many.”

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜

alternatives.note: This focuses on tasting or testing food and plants.
This is a natural, slightly more formal way to mean “especially.”

expressiveness.where: 然后，神农开始尝很多植物
expressiveness.idea: Add that he keeps trying plants because he wants to help people know which ones are safe.
expressiveness.example: 他想：我要帮大家找到能吃的植物。

expressiveness.where: 比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。
expressiveness.idea: Add a small detail that these plants are good for the body, like useful medicine plants.
expressiveness.example: 他发现这些植物对身体有好处。

expressiveness.where: 但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。
expressiveness.idea: Add a short warning that Shennong gives himself after finding a poisonous plant.
expressiveness.example: 神农说：“这种植物不能吃。”

feedback.encouragement: You clearly show that Shennong tries several different plants and give concrete examples such as ginger, kale, and spinach. You also make a useful contrast between good plants and dangerous ones.

scenes.text: 一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

corrections.correction: 一些植物不能吃 → 一些不能吃
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to omit 植物 here because it is repeated from the earlier phrase 一些植物能吃.

corrections.correction: 麻烦我们可以吃什… → 请问我们可以吃什…
corrections.explanation: 麻烦 means “trouble,” not a polite question opener. Use 请问 to begin a polite question.

corrections.correction: 这就要看你想不想生病… → 这就要看你想不想生病…
corrections.explanation: Here 看 means “depend on” in 要看……, so it is already correct. Do not change it to 看到, which means actually “see.”

alternatives.note: This means to explain something clearly to people.
This means to warn or remind people to be careful.
This is a natural alternative meaning “some,” often used when contrasting two groups.
This means “all kinds of” and shows there are many different plants.
This is a common alternative for becoming ill.
This is softer and describes feeling unwell.

expressiveness.where: 一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？
expressiveness.idea: You could make this a direct question and show that the person is worried about getting sick.
expressiveness.example: 那个人着急地问：“什么植物可以吃？”

expressiveness.where: 神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。
expressiveness.idea: You could add a clearer explanation: some plants are medicine, but poisonous plants can make people very ill.
expressiveness.example: 神农说：“有的植物可以做药，有的植物有毒，不能吃。”

expressiveness.where: 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。
expressiveness.idea: You could add that Shennong wrote the plant information in a book to help many people.
expressiveness.example: 神农把这些植物写在书上，帮助很多人。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly show the important lesson of this scene: people need to know which plants are safe to eat. You also include both Shennong’s answer and his effort to tell other people.

content: After 神农 starts trying plants, add that he finds 茶 and writes it down.
After trying other plants, add that 神农 eats 夹竹桃 and faints.
After 神农 faints from 夹竹桃, add that a person gives him 灵芝 and he feels better after eating it.
After the people talk with 神农, add that he writes down 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.

scenes.text: 古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

corrections.correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代
corrections.explanation: 古代 is the location/time setting for the action, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。

corrections.correction: 他找很多植物 → 他找了很多植物
corrections.explanation: 找 is a completed action in the story, so add 了: 找了。

corrections.correction: 可是有的吃了以后很舒… → 可是有的他吃了以后很舒…
corrections.explanation: The plants are not doing the eating. Add 他 to show that he eats them.

corrections.correction: 可是有的吃了以后很舒服 → 可是有的吃了之后很舒服
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 吃了之后 here. 之后 means “after” in this completed action sequence.

corrections.correction: ⟦他⟧叫神农
corrections.explanation: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce him briefly with an identifying noun phrase, not only 他.

corrections.correction: 有的植物吃了以后他的… → 有的植物他吃了以后他的…
corrections.explanation: The plants are not doing the eating. Add 他 to show that he eats the plants.

corrections.correction: 凉山很大的山 → 上了很大的山
corrections.explanation: This is a completed action in the story, so use 上了 with 了completed.

alternatives.note: A common, slightly more natural word for something interesting.
Shows that the plants seem surprising or amazing.
More specific for feeling physically better after pain or illness.

expressiveness.where: 一个男人觉得植物很有意思。
expressiveness.idea: You could add Shen Nong’s decision to discover which plants are safe to eat and which can be used as medicine.
expressiveness.example: 神农想：“我要找可以吃、可以做药的植物。”

expressiveness.where: 他找很多植物。
expressiveness.idea: You could describe that he walks through many mountains to look for plants.
expressiveness.example: 他走了很多高山，找了很多植物。

expressiveness.where: 有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。
expressiveness.idea: You could add that he wants to write down what each plant does, even though this work is difficult.
expressiveness.example: 他想把这些植物写在书上。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly introduce Shen Nong and show why plants catch his attention. The contrast between plants that cause stomach pain and plants that make him feel better is a strong start to the story.

scenes.text: 凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。

corrections.correction: 他找到黄色的花 → 他找了到黄色的花
corrections.explanation: The discovery is completed in the story, so add 了: 找到了.

corrections.correction: 你的头发疼死 → 你的头发疼得要死
corrections.explanation: Use 得 before the degree complement: 疼得要死.

corrections.correction: 他听说你跟黄色的花做茶… → 他听说你用黄色的花做茶…
corrections.explanation: Use 用 to say that the tea is made with yellow flowers.

corrections.correction: 你的头发疼死 → 你的头疼死
corrections.explanation: Use 头疼 for “have a headache.” 发 means “hair,” so delete it here.

corrections.correction: 他一喝茶就很不舒服 → 他一喝茶就觉得很不舒服
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 觉得很不舒服 to show that he feels uncomfortable.

corrections.correction: 这也找植物 → 他也找植物
corrections.explanation: Use 他 because this refers to Shennong, not to “this.”

corrections.correction: 你的头发疼死 → 的头发疼死
corrections.explanation: No second-person subject is intended here, so delete 你.

corrections.correction: 这冰茶是药 → 这种茶是药
corrections.explanation: Use 这种茶 to refer to this kind of tea from the previous context.

alternatives.note: a richer word for a bright, golden yellow color
a more vivid common word for feeling physically unwell
stronger; it shows more serious suffering

expressiveness.where: 一天，他找到黄色的花。
expressiveness.idea: Describe the flowers as big and beautiful, like little stars, to make the place clearer.
expressiveness.example: 黄色的花像星星一样，又大又漂亮。

expressiveness.where: 他一喝茶就很不舒服。
expressiveness.idea: Add his worried thought as quoted speech after he feels ill.
expressiveness.example: 他想：“我会死吗？”

expressiveness.where: 他一喝茶就很不舒服。
expressiveness.idea: Add a detail about his body, such as his stomach hurting badly.
expressiveness.example: 他的肚子疼得不得了。

feedback.encouragement: You give the scene a clear setting with a large mountain and introduce the yellow flowers. You also show that drinking the tea has an effect on Shennong, which moves the story forward.

scenes.text: 糟糕，这黄色的花是夹竹桃，特别是毒。正好在这儿，灵芝药的夹竹桃他吃完了，也写一个课文的植物。谢谢神农。

corrections.correction: 灵芝药的夹竹桃他… → 灵芝是药的夹竹桃他…
corrections.explanation: Use 是 to link 灵芝药 with its description: 灵芝药是……。

corrections.correction: 也写一个课文的植物 → 也写一个关于这种植物的课文
corrections.explanation: 课文的植物 means “a plant of the text.” Use 关于这种植物的课文 to show that the text is about this plant.

corrections.correction: 特别是毒 → 特别有毒
corrections.explanation: The structure needs an Adj. to describe 夹竹桃, but 毒 is a noun. Use 有毒.

corrections.correction: 也写一个课文的植… → 也写了一个课文的植…
corrections.explanation: The writing action is completed, so add 了 after 写.

corrections.correction: 也写一个课文的植物 → 也写一篇课文的植物
corrections.explanation: 篇 is the normal measure word for 课文, not 个.

corrections.correction: 灵芝药的夹竹… → 有灵芝药的夹竹…
corrections.explanation: Use 有 before 灵芝 to show that the medicine exists: 有灵芝药。

alternatives.note: a brighter, richer yellow
a light, soft yellow
a common stronger word for “very”
means especially or unusually; it sounds more vivid
a slightly more formal and stronger way to say thanks

expressiveness.where: 糟糕，这黄色的花是夹竹桃，特别是毒。
expressiveness.idea: Add how Shennong feels after eating the poisonous flower, such as strong stomach pain and fear.
expressiveness.example: 神农肚子很疼，难受得不得了。

expressiveness.where: 正好在这儿，灵芝药的夹竹桃他吃完了，也写一个课文的植物。
expressiveness.idea: Add a small detail about the helpful plant: it looks like an umbrella and helps him feel better quickly.
expressiveness.example: 他吃了像伞一样的灵芝，很快好多了。

expressiveness.where: 谢谢神农。
expressiveness.idea: Add a short thank-you sentence from Shennong to the man who helps him.
expressiveness.example: 神农说：“谢谢你，你救了我！”

feedback.encouragement: You clearly name the dangerous flower, 夹竹桃, and you also include 灵芝 in this scene. Starting with 糟糕 shows that you understand this is a sudden, dangerous moment.

content: Before 神农 tries 夹竹桃, add that he finds 茶 and records it.
After 灵芝 helps 神农 and before he writes his plant record, add a person in brown who comes and talks with 神农.
Wrong information: “他一喝茶就很不舒服。” — This says that 茶 made 神农 ill. In the story, he becomes ill after trying 夹竹桃; 茶 and 夹竹桃 are different plants.
Wrong information: “他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。” — This treats the yellow flower later identified as 夹竹桃 as useful for making tea, but 夹竹桃 is the poisonous plant in the story.

scenes.text: 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

corrections.correction: 告诉人什么植物是安… → 告诉人们什么植物是安…
corrections.explanation: Use 人们 when you mean people in general.

corrections.correction: …么植物是安全什么是危险 → …么植物是安全的什么是危险
corrections.explanation: 安全 describes the omitted noun 植物, so use 的: 是安全的.

corrections.correction: …全什么是危险 → …全什么是危险的
corrections.explanation: 危险 describes the omitted noun 植物, so use 的: 是危险的.

corrections.correction: 神农出去试一试很多种植物 → 神农出去尝了很多种植物
corrections.explanation: 试一试 does not normally collocate with plants in this situation; use 尝了 instead.

corrections.correction: 人不知道他们能吃什么植物 → 人不知道自己能吃什么植物
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to use 自己 to refer back to generic 人.

corrections.correction: ⟦神农⟧出去试一试很…
corrections.explanation: 神农 appears for the first time, so please introduce him briefly with an identifying noun phrase.

corrections.correction: 古代时候 → 古代
corrections.explanation: 时候 is redundant because 古代 already expresses the time.

alternatives.note: means “to be poisoned”; it is more precise for eating dangerous plants.
means “to become ill”; it is less final and fits what often happened to people.
means “poisonous”; it directly describes a dangerous plant.
means “cannot be eaten”; it is a clear, natural way to describe unsafe plants.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 神农出去试一试很多种植物

alternatives.note: means “set off”; it makes his journey sound more purposeful.
means “search for”; it emphasizes that he was looking for useful plants.

expressiveness.where: 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。
expressiveness.idea: Add that people often became sick after eating poisonous plants, so the danger feels more real.
expressiveness.example: 很多人吃了有毒的植物，常常生病。

expressiveness.where: 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。
expressiveness.idea: Add Shen Nong’s decision to find plants that could be medicine and plants that were poisonous.
expressiveness.example: 神农决定找出什么植物可以做药，什么植物有毒。

expressiveness.where: 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。
expressiveness.idea: Add a short thought to show that Shen Nong wanted to help people.
expressiveness.example: 他想：“我要帮大家找到安全的植物。”

feedback.encouragement: You clearly explain the main problem at the beginning: people did not know which plants were safe to eat. You also give Shen Nong a clear purpose—testing plants to help other people.

scenes.text: 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚。他告诉朋友：“你吃哪种植物，这就要看你的口味。比方说，你爱吃甜的，可能喜欢糖。”他最喜欢吃花，除了夹竹桃以外，什么都花想吃。

corrections.correction: 什么都花想吃 → 什么花都想吃
corrections.explanation: Put 花 after 什么 and before 都: 什么花都想吃. This word order means “want to eat every kind of flower.”

corrections.correction: …感觉又暖和又清楚 → …感觉又暖和又舒服
corrections.explanation: 清楚 cannot describe how your stomach feels. Use 舒服 for a warm, comfortable stomach feeling.

corrections.correction: 这就要看你的口味 → 这就要看你的口味
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 看 here: 口味 is something you consider or judge, not something you literally 看到see.

corrections.correction: 可能喜欢糖 → ，这样可以吃糖喜欢糖
corrections.explanation: Use ，这样可以吃糖 to show the connection: if you like sweet food, then you can eat candy.

alternatives.note: This is a natural way to say something benefits the body.
This is a slightly more formal word meaning beneficial.
This means especially and sounds a little more polished.
This means to explain something clearly to someone.

expressiveness.where: 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚。
expressiveness.idea: Add that Shennong puts the tea in water and finds that it is both a tasty drink and medicine.
expressiveness.example: 他把茶放在水里，觉得很好喝，还可以做药。

expressiveness.where: 他告诉朋友：
expressiveness.idea: Let Shennong say with excitement that he has found a useful plant, using direct speech.
expressiveness.example: 他说：“茶对身体很好，我要把它写在书上！”

expressiveness.where: 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚。
expressiveness.idea: Add that he writes down his discovery so that other people can know about it.
expressiveness.example: 他把茶写到书上，告诉大家茶可以做药。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly show that Shennong discovers plants that are good for the body, and tea is a strong specific example. You also use direct speech, which makes this part of the story more lively.

scenes.text: 他发现这个口味，一百岁时候，不小心吃了毒的花。一吃就开始死。但是生病时候告诉人什么植物是药，什么植物是毒。

corrections.correction: 但是生病时候告诉人什… → 但是生病的时候告诉人什…
corrections.explanation: Use 的 before 时候 in this time phrase: 生病的时候.

corrections.correction: 一百岁时候 → 一百岁的时候
corrections.explanation: 一百岁的时候 is the established time expression. Use 的 before 时候.

corrections.correction: 不小心吃了毒的花 → 不小心吃了有毒的花
corrections.explanation: Here the structure needs an adjective before 花, but 毒 is a noun. Use 有毒的花.

corrections.correction: 什么植物是毒 → 什么是毒
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to avoid repeating 植物. After 什么植物是药, you can say 什么是毒.

corrections.correction: 什么植物是毒 → 什么植物有毒
corrections.explanation: Here the structure needs an adjective, but 毒 is a noun. Use 有毒: 什么植物有毒.

corrections.correction: 一吃就开始死 → 一吃就会死
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to say 一吃就会死. 会 shows the result that will happen after eating it.

corrections.correction: 一吃就开始死 → 一吃就开始死亡
corrections.explanation: It would be more natural to use 开始死亡 here; 死 is not normally used after 开始 for one person.

vocabulary_suggestions.phrase: 告诉人什么植物是药，什么植物是毒。

alternatives.note: means to warn or remind people, especially about danger.
means to explain something clearly.
means a plant or material used as medicine; it is more specific.

expressiveness.where: 一吃就开始死。
expressiveness.idea: Add how Shennong’s body feels after eating the flower, such as strong stomach pain and discomfort.
expressiveness.example: 他肚子很疼，很难受。

expressiveness.where: 但是生病时候告诉人什么植物是药，什么植物是毒。
expressiveness.idea: Add a short warning that Shennong says to others about the dangerous flower.
expressiveness.example: 他说：“这种花不能吃。”

expressiveness.where: 他发现这个口味，一百岁时候，不小心吃了毒的花。
expressiveness.idea: Describe the flower a little more, for example its bright colour and star-like shape.
expressiveness.example: 那是黄色的、像星星一样的花。

feedback.encouragement: You clearly show the important result of this scene: Shennong eats a harmful flower but still teaches people which plants can be medicine. You also use “不小心” well to show that the accident was not planned.

content: At the beginning, say that people often got sick after eating plants they did not know, not that they died.
After finding 茶, add that 神农 tried 夹竹桃 and fainted.
After 神农 faints, add that a person gave him 灵芝 and he felt better after eating it.
After he felt better, add another person who came and talked with 神农.
After the visitors talk with 神农, add that he recorded 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.
Wrong information: “古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。” — In the story, people often became sick after eating unknown plants, not died.
Wrong information: “他最喜欢吃花，除了夹竹桃以外，什么都花想吃。” — This says 神农 did not eat 夹竹桃, but in the story he tries 夹竹桃 and faints.
Wrong information: “一吃就开始死。” — After trying 夹竹桃, 神农 faints in the story; he does not start to die.
